title: Generative AI for Professionals: Beginner to Pro

01genai-syllabus-2026-complete-roadmap-f.title: 01. GenAI Syllabus 2026: Complete Roadmap from LLM Foundations to Production Deployment
01genai-syllabus-2026-complete-roadmap-f.description: An 8-month roadmap to becoming a GenAI engineer. It covers 18 modules, including LLMs, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic AI, MCP, evaluation, guardrails, and cloud deployment, and ends with an end-to-end project. No ML/DL background is required.
